ayahs.translation: The Reality
What is the Reality
Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is
(The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come
As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning

ayahs.text: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
ayahs.translation: And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind

ayahs.text: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
ayahs.translation: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees
Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them

ayahs.text: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
ayahs.translation: And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error

ayahs.text: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
ayahs.translation: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip

ayahs.text: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
ayahs.translation: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship

ayahs.text: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
ayahs.translation: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember

ayahs.text: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
ayahs.translation: And when the trumpet shall sound one blast

ayahs.text: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
ayahs.translation: And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash
Then, on that day will the Event befall
And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail

ayahs.text: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَٰنِيَةٌ
ayahs.translation: And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them

ayahs.text: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
ayahs.translation: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden

ayahs.text: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
ayahs.translation: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book
Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning
Then he will be in blissful state
In a high garden
Whereof the clusters are in easy reach

ayahs.text: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
ayahs.translation: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days

ayahs.text: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
ayahs.translation: But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book
And knew not what my reckoning
Oh, would that it had been death
My wealth hath not availed me
My power hath gone from me
(It will be said): Take him and fetter him
And then expose him to hell-fire

ayahs.text: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
ayahs.translation: And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits

ayahs.text: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.translation: Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous
And urged not on the feeding of the wretched
Therefor hath he no lover here this day
Nor any food save filth
Which none but sinners eat
But nay! I swear by all that ye see
And all that ye see not
That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger

ayahs.text: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.translation: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe

ayahs.text: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.translation: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember
It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds
And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us
We assuredly had taken him by the right hand
And then severed his life-artery

ayahs.text: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
ayahs.translation: And not one of you could have held Us off from him
And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil)
And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it)
And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers
And lo! it is absolute truth
So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord
